description: Find open or upcoming EU grant calls that fit a company's or project's topic. Searches the European Commission's Funding & Tenders Portal by keyword: topic ID, title, programme, action type, opening date, deadline, days left, budget per grant (EUR), expected number of grants and official link. Expired legacy topics are filtered out. Use when scouting Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, LIFE, CEF, EU4Health or similar funding. $0.02 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: search_eu_grants
